title: Low guard hoops replace the ducts
summary: Each prop has a low solid guard 4 mm tall (guard_h), centred on the prop plane, 2 mm outside the tips, 1.4 mm wall, with no windows. It was decided as a full hoop; a later decision ('Guards are outer arcs') fixed only the outer half and left the rest to the optimiser (guard_arc_deg 180). The frame's limbs reach each guard from below; nothing covers the prop from above. Settled by C13 (guard height: 4 mm when decided, at most 4.5 mm as printed since) and C14 (the frame's shadow on a prop's disc: at most 10 % when decided, 15 % since).

rejected.why: the r/diydrones review: the 10.9 mm ducts make propwash in climbs and rolls, and their windows add layer perimeter, so weight, instead of removing it
more mass than hoops for protection a kid indoors does not need; the author chose low hoops in the interview (2026-10-17)
props exposed to fingers and furniture indoors (R1, R3); the author chose low hoops in the interview (2026-10-17)
the heaviest option, and any thrust gain from a duct is unconfirmed (v0.1's A1 took the ducts to cost 10 % of thrust); the author chose low hoops in the interview (2026-10-17)
